verdict: Yes. Artociti from Bokaro Steel City pitched relief mural home decor on Shark Tank India Season 5 and got a deal. Three-dimensional wall murals sell at high prices to homes, hotels and offices, and each piece is made to order.
angle: Relief murals made of resin, clay or metal work well as statement pieces in homes, hotels, restaurants and offices. Interior designers and architects are the key buyers. Installation, safe shipping and custom design capacity decide growth.
